hooks.command: bash -c 'FP=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); if echo "$FP" | grep -qE "\.(pbxproj|xcworkspace|xib|storyboard)$|xcodeproj/|xcworkspace/"; then PROJDIR=$(echo "$FP" | sed -E "s#/[^/]+\.(xcodeproj|xcworkspace)/.*##"); if [ -f "$PROJDIR/project.yml" ]; then echo "BLOCKED: this project is generated by XcodeGen - a hand-edited .pbxproj is overwritten by the next \"xcodegen generate\". Create the source file, then run \"xcodegen generate\" and commit the regenerated .pbxproj alongside it." >&2; else echo "BLOCKED: Do not modify Xcode project files directly. Create Swift files and add them to the target in Xcode." >&2; fi; exit 2; fi'

bash -c 'FP=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); if echo "$FP" | grep -qE "\.entitlements$"; then echo "BLOCKED: Do not modify .entitlements files without explicit user permission." >&2; exit 2; fi'

bash -c 'CMD=$(jq -r ".tool_input.command // empty"); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "\b(git|gh)\b.*--(force-with-lease|force|no-verify|admin)\b"; then echo "BLOCKED: --force/--force-with-lease/--no-verify/--admin bypass safety checks (core rule 8). If truly necessary, stop and ask the user first." >&2; exit 2; fi'
bash -c 'FP=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); if echo "$FP" | grep -qE "\.swift$"; then swiftformat --config "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/{{COMPONENT_PREFIX}}.swiftformat" "$FP" --quiet; fi'

bash -c 'FP=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); if echo "$FP" | grep -qE "\.swift$"; then out=$(swiftlint lint --strict --config "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/{{COMPONENT_PREFIX}}.swiftlint.yml" --quiet "$FP" 2>&1) || { printf "%s\n" "$out" >&2; exit 2; }; fi'
